messages:
kevin: quick thread 1 about packaging/pricing visibility for Acme across AWS/GCP/Azure. partner asked whether trial converts to meter or a paid SKU automatically. thoughts?

amanda: recommend private-offer trial (30d) + manual conversion. partner control avoids unexpected billing flows.

sarah: ops note: if we go meter-on-consumption post-trial we need clear SKU mapping per cloud and example webhook flow. also need to surface marketplace fee visibility in partner docs.

legal: legal wants a short clause for marketplace pages: trial duration, data collected (usage metadata only), and no automatic billing unless customer consents. will draft.

kevin: can someone paste a tiny sample mapping for partner (cloud -> post-trial SKU)?

ops-bot: sample mapping (sanitized):
```text
Azure: offerId=REDACTED, plan=payg-std
GCP: sku=redwood-payg-standard
AWS: listingId=redwood-saas-payg
```

kevin: perfect. action items: amanda = confirm partner prefers manual conversion, sarah = prepare mapping & webhook test, legal = post short blurb by EOD. i'll sync with partner tomorrow 9am PT.
